settings.description: The maximum number of a class points a player is allowed to select when setting up their characters. Admins will still be able to add more classes manually, up to the Maximum allowed class number.
The ABSOLUTE maximum number of a class points a player may have. Does NOT control the number allowed to be selected by the player, but the total amount they can have (via admins adding classes).
Should the class selection UI be opened on-spawn?
The minimum number of class points a player MUST select.
Should players in Creative Mode be allowed to craft in all class benches, regardless of their classes?
Should players be prevented from stealing the worn armor from players who are surrendering?
Enable the alternate player name feature.
Should players only be allowed to set their alternate name on spawn?

The minimum amount of minutes that must pass for a player to be able to switch their name to and from their alternate.
Set to 0.0 for no cooldown.
If a player is currently under cooldown to change between their alt and normal names, always allow them to return to their normal name.
The default alternate name used when players are setting up.
The maximum number of characters allowed in a players's alternate name.
Enable logging for when players access the inventory of another player.
Enable logging for when players access the inventory of a non-owned structure.
Enable logging for when players access the inventory of a non-owned (tamed) dino.
Enable logging for when admins make changes to any RPTools feature, or player data.
Enable logging for when RPTools makes any changes to a player's name.
Enable logging for when players enable or disable their alternate name.
